message:
Hey, that nameless user here.

I wrote Miso as an experimental bot to test perchance's AI capabilities, and the AI would occasionally make up random stuff while talking, which lead to some rather interesting rules being written in the original version..

Didn't expect somebody to actually rewrote my bot, so I might as well rewrite it back too.
